+from __future__ import (absolute_import, division, print_function)

+@pytest.fixture
+def collections(tmp_path, mocker):
+    paths = {}
+    metadata = {}
+    real_metadata = amc._get_collection_metadata
+    real_import = amc.import_module
+
+    def add(name):
+        path = tmp_path.joinpath(*name.split('.'))
+        path.mkdir(parents=True)
+        paths[name] = path
+        metadata[name] = {'plugin_routing': {'module_utils': {}}}
+        return path / 'plugins' / 'module_utils'
+
+    def get_metadata(name):
+        if name in metadata:
+            return metadata[name]
+        return real_metadata(name)
+
+    def import_collection(name):
+        if name.startswith('ansible_collections.'):
+            collection = name[len('ansible_collections.'):]
+            if collection in paths:
+                return SimpleNamespace(__path__=[str(paths[collection])])
+        return real_import(name)
+
+    mocker.patch.object(amc, '_get_collection_metadata', side_effect=get_metadata)
+    mocker.patch.object(amc, 'import_module', side_effect=import_collection)
+    return add, metadata
+
+
+def bundle(source):
+    names = {('ansible', '__init__'), ('ansible', 'module_utils', '__init__')}
+    cache = {}
+    output = BytesIO()
+    with ZipFile(output, 'w') as payload:
+        payload.writestr('ansible/__init__.py', b'')
+        payload.writestr('ansible/module_utils/__init__.py', b'')
+        amc.recursive_finder('test', 'ansible_collections.ns.coll.plugins.modules.test',
+                             source, names, cache, payload)
+    with ZipFile(output) as payload:
+        return {name: payload.read(name) for name in payload.namelist()}
+
+
+def write_file(path, source):
+    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    path.write_text(source)
+
+
+def test_package_initializer_relative_imports_and_missing_intermediate_inits(collections):
+    add, unused = collections
+    root = add('ns.coll')
+    write_file(root / 'pkg' / '__init__.py', 'from .submod import X\nfrom ..cousin.submod import Y\n')
+    write_file(root / 'pkg' / 'submod.py', 'X = 1\n')
+    write_file(root / 'cousin' / 'submod.py', 'Y = 2\n')
+    write_file(root / 'deep' / 'nested' / 'leaf.py', 'leaf = 3\n')
+
+    payload = bundle(b'from ansible_collections.ns.coll.plugins.module_utils.pkg import X\n'
+                     b'from ansible_collections.ns.coll.plugins.module_utils.deep.nested.leaf import leaf\n')
+    prefix = 'ansible_collections/ns/coll/plugins/module_utils/'
+    assert payload[prefix + 'pkg/__init__.py'].startswith(b'from .submod import X')
+    assert payload[prefix + 'pkg/submod.py'] == b'X = 1\n'
+    assert payload[prefix + 'cousin/submod.py'] == b'Y = 2\n'
+    assert payload[prefix + 'cousin/__init__.py'] == b''
+    assert payload[prefix + 'deep/__init__.py'] == b''
+    assert payload[prefix + 'deep/nested/__init__.py'] == b''
+    assert payload[prefix + 'deep/nested/leaf.py'] == b'leaf = 3\n'
+    for package in ('ansible_collections', 'ansible_collections/ns', 'ansible_collections/ns/coll',
+                    'ansible_collections/ns/coll/plugins', 'ansible_collections/ns/coll/plugins/module_utils'):
+        assert package + '/__init__.py' in payload

+def test_collection_redirect_wins_and_bundles_cross_collection_target(collections):

+    write_file(target_root / 'real.py', 'remote = True\n')

+
+    payload = bundle(b'import ansible_collections.ns.coll.plugins.module_utils.old\n')
+    shim = payload['ansible_collections/ns/coll/plugins/module_utils/old.py']
+    assert b'ansible_collections.other.coll.plugins.module_utils.real' in shim
+    assert b'local = True' not in shim

+def test_redirected_package_supports_attribute_and_child_imports(collections, tmp_path):
+    add, metadata = collections

+    target_root = add('other.coll')
+    write_file(target_root / 'pkg' / '__init__.py', 'VALUE = 1\n')
+    write_file(target_root / 'pkg' / 'child.py', 'from ..cousin import Y\nCHILD = Y\n')
+    write_file(target_root / 'cousin.py', 'Y = 2\n')
+    metadata['ns.coll']['plugin_routing']['module_utils']['alias'] = {'redirect': 'other.coll.pkg'}
+
+    payload = bundle(b'from ansible_collections.ns.coll.plugins.module_utils.alias import VALUE, child\n')
+    prefix = 'ansible_collections/ns/coll/plugins/module_utils/'
+    target_prefix = 'ansible_collections/other/coll/plugins/module_utils/'
